summary: This page shows how many cases were filed, decided and still pending in the courts of {district}, with the average time a case takes, from the National Judicial Data Grid (NJDG). Figures are grouped by court and year.
emptyBody: We are collecting case pendency and disposal data from the National Judicial Data Grid (NJDG).
explain: In {year}, the courts here received {filed} new cases and had {pending} cases still waiting. Out of every 10 of these cases, about {n} were still waiting for a decision.
picto: About {n} of every 10 cases were still pending in {year}.
rateNote: Cases still waiting, as a share of new and waiting cases
ringsUnits: Cases decided as a share of new cases filed, for each court. 100% or more means the court decided at least as many cases as it received.
ringsUnitsTop: Cases decided as a share of new cases filed, for each court. 100% or more means the court decided at least as many cases as it received. The {n} courts with the most new cases are shown.
ringsSimple: {kept} of {n} {n, plural, one {court} other {courts}} decided at least as many cases as came in.
ringsAria: {court}: decided {pct} of the new cases in {year}
chartUnits: Number of cases per court. Grey is new cases filed, colour is cases decided, red is cases still pending.
